title: Know your audience
and your edge.
quote: Know the enemy and know yourself; in a hundred battles you will never be in peril.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Before you post, know who it's for and what only you can say.

head: Where they overlap
is your niche.
s2.body: Their problems plus your unique angle = content only you can make.

head: Answer three
questions first.
items: What can I say that others can't?
s3.body: Write the answers down before you write a single script.

do: Only make content at the overlap
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 1: Know your audience and know yourself. Your niche lives where their problems meet your edge. 30s ↓

title: Win in planning,
not in posting.
quote: Every battle is won before it is fought.
meaning: Most of a video's success is decided before you hit record.

head: Plan the battle
before you fight it.
s2.body: Research, hook and script decide the outcome. Posting is the last step.

head: A weak idea can't
be edited strong.
s3.body: A strong hook planned up front beats hours of editing.

do: Plan the week on a calendar
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 2: Every battle is won before it's fought. Your video wins in planning, not in the edit. 30s ↓

title: Ride the
news cycle.
quote: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
meaning: Launches, updates and trends are openings, if you move fast.

head: Attention peaks
fast, then fades.
s2.body: Interest in something new spikes at launch, then drops off.

head: Timing
beats polish.
s3.body: Be early with something useful, not late with something perfect.

do: Post within days of big news
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 3: In chaos there is opportunity. A good video in launch week beats a perfect one a month late. 30s ↓

title: Underpromise,
overdeliver.
quote: Appear weak when you are strong.
meaning: Let your content outperform its title, not the other way around.

head: The payoff should
beat the promise.
s2.body: A plain title with a big payoff earns trust and rewatches.

head: Trust compounds.
Clickbait doesn't.
s3.body: Viewers remember who wasted their time.

do: Cut the hype words from titles
Add one tip they didn't expect
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 4: Appear weak when you are strong. Underpromise in the title, overdeliver in the video. 30s ↓

title: Attack where they're
unprepared.
quote: Attack him where he is unprepared, appear where you are not expected.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Find the gaps the big creators leave open.

head: Crowded topics
leave gaps.
s2.body: Everyone covers the obvious. The gaps are where you win.

head: Where the
gaps hide.
s3.body: Search your niche's questions and look for weak answers.

do: Read the comments on top videos
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 5: Attack where they're unprepared. The gaps big creators leave are your best topics. 30s ↓

title: Speed is
a strategy.
quote: Speed is the essence of war.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Ship, learn, improve. Momentum beats perfection.

head: Every post
is a lesson.
s2.body: Each upload gives you data to make the next one better.

head: Perfectionism lets
the moment pass.
s3.body: The video you post today teaches more than the one you keep polishing.

do: Set a schedule you can keep
Cap your editing time per video
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 6: Speed is the essence of war. Ship, learn, improve: momentum beats perfection. 30s ↓

title: Win without
fighting.
quote: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Don't compete head-on. Own a space so clearly you're the obvious choice.

head: Narrow until you're
the only one.
s2.body: The narrower the category, the fewer rivals you face.

head: Positioning
is a moat.
s3.body: Become the default answer for one specific thing.

hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 7: Win without fighting. Don't battle giants for broad keywords. Own one narrow category. 30s ↓

title: Repurpose
everything.
quote: Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
meaning: One idea, done once, can become five pieces of content.

head: One script,
five platforms.
s2.body: Each format reaches a different audience with the same work.

head: Each piece opens
the next.
s3.label: posts from one idea
s3.body: Every version is another chance for the right person to find you.

do: Write once, in a master script
Adapt the hook for each platform
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 8: Opportunities multiply as they are seized. One script can become five posts. 30s ↓

title: Your analytics
are intelligence.
quote: If you know neither the enemy nor yourself, you will succumb in every battle.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Your data tells you what's working, if you read it honestly.

head: Find where
viewers leave.
s2.body: A retention curve shows the exact second you lose people.

head: Your intelligence
report.
s3.body: Double down on what works. Cut what doesn't, even ideas you love.

do: Remake your top post in a new format
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 9: If you don't know yourself, you lose every battle. Your analytics are your intelligence report. 30s ↓

title: Build systems
before you scale.
quote: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
attr: Sun Tzu, The Art of War
meaning: Templates and workflows mean every video starts from a winning position.

head: A system does
the heavy lifting.
s2.body: Reusable templates and a set schedule remove the daily guesswork.

head: Systems beat
willpower.
s3.body: Consistency comes from a process, not motivation.

do: Turn your best video into a template
Write your workflow down, step by step
Batch and schedule a week at a time
hook: Art of War for creators, Lesson 10: Victorious warriors win first, then go to war. Build systems before you scale. 30s ↓
